entities.summary: Giuseppe Ayala  is an Italian politician and magistrate. He was known as an "anti-mafia" magistrate, and served as "anti-Mafia" judge. He raised doubts about whether it was only the Mafia that was involved in the killing of Giovanni Falcone. In 1993, Ayala published a book entitled La guerra dei giusti. I giudici, la mafia, la politica, detailing his experiences in politics and his encounters with the mafia.
